purpose: Define deterministic grouping and aggregation semantics with explicit group keys, aggregate functions, null handling, lineage summary and classification propagation.

topics.name: DWH Query Aggregation
topics.purpose: Define deterministic grouping and aggregation semantics with explicit group keys, aggregate functions, null handling, lineage summary and classification propagation.

semantics.null_rule: Null/missing handling is explicit per aggregate/profile.
semantics.result_rule: Aggregate outputs are derived values with distinct result-field identities.
semantics.lineage_rule: Aggregate output retains provenance to contributing source set or bounded lineage summary.
semantics.classification_rule: Aggregation does not implicitly declassify; classification is propagated unless explicit declassification applies.
semantics.determinism_rule: Equivalent inputs and aggregate profile yield semantically equivalent results.
semantics.authority_rule: Aggregate access does not bypass source/output governance.

invariants.rule: A DWH query is an explicit read/projection definition over exact resolved schema/instance/relation identities; querying, filtering, joining, aggregating, ordering or paginating never silently changes source ownership, identity or authorization.
